:::{#thm-pois-score}
#### Score function of a Poisson variable

Let $X \sim \Pois(\rate)$.
The score of a single observation $x$ with respect to $\rate$
is its deviation from the mean, divided by the variance:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \rate}{\rate}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-pois-score-fn.

:::
